videos.script: A book's ISBN, its title, its year. Some classes are nothing but data, and writing one by hand fills a page. A constructor, three getters, equals, hashCode and toString. Every one of them is a place to make a mistake. {{record}} A record is one line that says: these are the fields, and that is all. The compiler writes the rest, and javap shows exactly what it wrote. {{compact}} Then the one place to add your own code: a constructor that checks the data and tidies it, before the fields are fixed for good. And a trap, because a record holding a list is only as immutable as the list. {{patterns}} Then the reason records arrived together with pattern matching. A switch can take a record apart into its fields, and with a sealed interface the compiler knows every case. {{limits}} Last, when not to use one. By the end you can tell data from an object with a life of its own.
